title: The Remote — Sc094: Nicole dives over the car (photo-plate garage stunt)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: Stunt staging on a photographic plate with an unfinished prop: the shot opens on ~14 frames of empty parking-garage photo plate with only a blue layout-line car in it, then Nicole drops in from the TOP of the frame (not through any door), tumbles, stretches into a full horizontal dive over the car roof (~frame 35), lands past it (~frame 42) and holds an angry crouch (~frame 49) before vanishing, leaving the empty plate again. The entire performance lives inside one nested master symbol ('Mom angry run rough', 1752 kf) placed over a single 'bg' symbol; the comedy and the danger come from trajectory and timing against a static plate, not from camera moves or extra drawings -- the car itself is never even painted.
notes: Empty-plate opening: frames 1-15 show only the photographic garage plate and the blue-line car; Nicole enters from the top edge around frame 15 -- the stunt is set up by absence.
The whole performance is one nested master symbol, 'Mom angry run rough' (1752 kf), placed 18 times on the 'Mom Angry run Cycle' layer over the 'bg' symbol and the 'mom' layer.
The car is never painted: it stays a blue layout outline in all 56 frames, and the dive still reads because the character and plate carry the shot.
Bookend staging: the last frame (56) returns to the exact empty plate + line car of frame 1 -- she is gone as fast as she arrived.
